mLocKeys.keySummary: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yone enters a spirit form for @ReturnTimer@ seconds, leaving his body behind for the duration and gaining @StartingMS*100@% to @MovementSpeed*100@% ramping Move Speed.

When the spirit form ends, Yone snaps back to his body and repeats @DeathmarkPercent*100@% of all Attack and Ability damage he dealt to champions during this time. You may Recast this ability during spirit form.

Recast: End spirit form early.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Yone cannot snap back while affected by hard crowd control.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has been marked by Soul Unbound, and will take damage when it ends.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Yone deals magic damage with every second Attack. In addition, his critical strike chance is increased.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Steel and Spirit: Yone uses two blades, causing every second Attack to deal @MagicDamageSplit*100@% magic damage.

Intent: Yone's Critical Strike Chance is increased by @CritChanceMultiplier*100@% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to @CurrentCritDamage@. Gain @YoneCritToAD*.01@ Bonus AD for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_YonePassive_Tooltip}}

Intent is calculated after other Critical Strike Chance modifying effects.
Current bonus: @f2@% Critical Strike Chance, @f3@ Bonus Attack Damage.

mBuff.mDescription: Yone's next stack will empower Mortal Steel.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Yone's next stack will empower Mortal Steel.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.

On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yone thrusts forward, dealing @QDamage@ physical damage.

On hit, grants a stack for @BuffDuration@ seconds. At 2 stacks, this ability causes Yone to dash forward with a wave of wind that Knocks Up for @Q3KnockupDuration@ seconds and deals @QDamage@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability acts like an Attack: it can critically strike for <physicalDamage>@TotalDamageCrit@ physical damage</physicalDamage>, it applies %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-hit</OnHit> effects and lifesteal to the first enemy struck, is interruptible by crowd control, and its cooldown and cast time are reduced with <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed>.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Yone strikes all enemies along a path for <physicalDamage>@TooltipDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <magicDamage>@TooltipDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, teleporting behind the last champion hit and <status>Knocking Up</status> victims towards Yone.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>If no enemy champion is struck, Yone will instead blink to maximum range.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Shield granted after striking champions with Spirit Cleave.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone. Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit by the swipe.

Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yone cleaves forward, dealing @BaseDamage*0.5@ + @MaxHealthDamage*50@% max Health physical damage and @BaseDamage*0.5@ + @MaxHealthDamage*50@% max Health magic damage.

If Yone hits, he gains @WShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. The amount of Shield increases for each champion struck.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Shield increased by @FirstChampShieldMultiplier*100@% for the first champion hit and @SecondChampShieldMultiplier*100@% for all subsequent champions.
This abilities cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed.
